text:
samir: Heads-up — customer acme_integration says invoice token total is ~30% lower than our dashboard for a week. They use streaming chat and often cancel client-side. Request id: r_9a2b3c.
eli: Can you paste a minimal repro or the exact SDK call they use?
samir: They provided a snippet: ```js
const es = new EventSource('/v1/stream?model=gpt-4o');
es.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data === '[DONE]') es.close(); }
setTimeout(() => es.close(), 850); // client abort after ~850ms
```
maya: Customer sent invoice link and sample timestamps. They say dashboard shows 120k tokens for the period, invoice charged for 85k.
billing_ops: Looking at logs for r_9a2b3c — we have token_emitted events (stream chunks) tallying ~118k, but tokens_finalized events only ~80k. There are many client_disconnect events with no finalize.
ingrid: Hypothesis: our meter finalization is triggered on model end-of-stream signal, not on client disconnect. If client cancels mid-generation and we drop the tail token-finalize step, those tokens never get billed.
ops_jeff: Can we repro locally? Quick curl example to exercise SSE + client abort: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"stream":true,"max_tokens":200}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream | tee /dev/null & sleep 0.6; kill $!
```
eli: If repro works, we should add a server-side path that flushes/serializes partial token counts on socket close. Also add a metric: tokens_counted_on_disconnect.
samir: Customer asked for a reconciliation while we fix it — they need invoice adj if we undercharged them, or explanation if invoice is higher.
billing_ops: For immediate reconciliation, I can provide per-request raw token_emitted logs for the account for the date range. Sending as CSV to the sales rep.
ingrid: Long-term: proposal to emit an intermediate 'partial_finalize' event whenever we observe client abort or SSE connection reset. That will be consumed by billing pipeline.
maya: I've flagged this as P1 with the customer and created internal ticket INF-2217.
eli: I'll prototype a small change: on socket teardown call finalize_tokens(request_id) and persist final count. If any gap remains, we'll backfill using emitted_chunk_counts.
samir: Thanks. @billing_ops please reconcile and let the customer know ETA.
billing_ops: Will do, sending files by EOD. :+1:
